messages:
rina: FYI ran a short-span holdout for cormorant-lite-v2 (fp16 -> int8-perchannel) against cormorant-holdouts-v5. noticed unusual top1 drop for queries with multiple proper nouns.
chao: how big is the delta?
rina: small table: cohort=short-names (<=6 tokens)
```
model    recall@1  recall@5  median_norm
v2(fp16) 0.67 0.84 1.12
v3(int8) 0.55 0.82 0.95
delta   -0.12 -0.02 -0.17
```
tom: median_norm drop is suspicious. did you change whitening or apply different L2 scaling?
rina: no pipeline changes. quant profile int8-perchannel-q1, compile default kernel fast-k12. saved vectors to s3://redwood-evals/cormorant/1771112222/ for inspection.
eval-bot: queued cormorant-retest-1771112222-A (int8 + per-channel bias-corr). queued cormorant-retest-1771112222-B (fp16 compile with k12). ETA 15m.
chao: also try compile v3 with legacy-k4 (v2 used k4). kernel differences + quant can shift scale.
rina: compiling legacy-k4 now. quick probe: turning off L2-normalize during eval bumped r@1 to 0.58 (still -0.09).
tom: sounds like quant compresses rare-dim signal for named entities. can we run a targeted probe that masks rare tokens to see sensitivity?
rina: creating ML ticket ML-1902: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-1902. attaching failures and eval commands. assigning to @chao and @tom.
eval-bot: cormorant-retest-1771112222-A finished -> recall@1=0.60 (delta -0.07). cormorant-retest-1771112222-B finished -> recall@1=0.66 (delta -0.01).
chao: compile with fp16 but use v3 quant scale ops to see if kernel alone explains. if B nearly closes gap, kernel is primary.
infra-bot: infra quota available for extra re-runs if requested.
rina: next steps per ticket: 1) combined run (int8 + bias-corr + legacy-k4) 2) synthetic mask probe for rare tokens 3) add a short-names cohort alert when r@1 delta > 0.08 over 30m 4) contingency: route short-names queries to fp16 v2 until fix. target: decision by EOD.
tom: thanks — please paste re-run ids/results here when ready.
